We were up against a strong shortlist of established fintech companies, and we’re proud to bring the award home for the work we’ve put into building and scaling in Ireland.
What the National Fintech Awards recognize

Organized by the Business Post in association with GRID Finance, the National Fintech Awards celebrate achievement across the Irish fintech industry, from early-stage start-ups to the most established names. The 2026 awards spanned 17 categories, each judged against its own criteria.

The Fintech Company of the Year awards look for companies that show real innovation, progress, and market influence. Why Ireland

Ireland is a core part of how we serve clients across Europe. Our Irish entities are regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland and provide crypto brokerage and MiCA custody to clients in the EEA, and operate our MiCA-authorized trading platform. Payward also holds an EMI license from the Central Bank of Ireland, which sits alongside our other regulated infrastructure as part of Payward Banking.

We didn’t build here to tick a box. We built here because Ireland offers the talent, the regulatory clarity, and the fintech ecosystem you need to build a global financial services company that clients can trust.
Building on a regulated foundation

We think about growth in Ireland the same way we think about growth everywhere: one license, one market, one layer of infrastructure at a time. A clear regulatory framework lets us build the products clients actually use and stand behind them with confidence. Those products need to be secure, transparent, and ready to scale.

That approach is also why Europe features so prominently in our wider roadmap. Earlier this month, Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Saldo Bank, a digital-first, EU-licensed bank, as the next step in building out the EU layer of Payward Banking.
Built for clients across Europe

The foundation we’ve built in Ireland supports the products we bring to clients across the EEA. This week, we made Unified Wallet available to EEA clients on Kraken Pro, so clients can use their existing spot, margin, and earn balances as futures collateral without moving funds between wallets. We’ve also brought US-listed stocks to European clients, bridging traditional markets and crypto in one place.
The goal is the same every time: give clients one place to hold, trade, and put their assets to work, backed by the regulatory standards they should expect from a financial institution.
What’s next

We’re proud of this recognition, but we’re even more motivated by what’s ahead. We’ll keep investing in Ireland, keep expanding what we offer to clients across Europe, and keep building the regulated infrastructure that makes it possible. This award is a great milestone, and we’re just getting started.

For the purpose of this Promotion, “Rising Traders” refers to users who, as of three days before the start of the Promotion Period, have won any rewards in fewer than 3 previous Binance Wallet’s Alpha trading competitions.
Eligible Rising Traders will receive a 1.2x Rising Trader Boost on their actual trading volume during the Promotion Period, subject to a Rising Trader Boost Cap.
Notes:
The "Rising Trader" qualification is determined as of three days before the activity period begins.

For example, if a user wins a trading competition ending on Day T, and their cumulative historical win count reaches exactly 3 at that point, they will still qualify as a Rising Trader for new competitions starting on T+1 and T+2 (since the qualification snapshot was taken before their 3rd win). However, for competitions starting on T+3 and beyond, their historical win count will already be 3 or more at the qualification snapshot, and they will no longer be eligible for the Rising Trader bonus.

The Rising Trader Boost Cap refers to the maximum actual trading volume that can receive the Rising Trader Boost during the Promotion Period. Once a user’s Rising Trader Boost Cap has been reached, the user will no longer receive Rising Trader Boosts for any subsequent trading volume.
If both the Early Bird Boost Multiplier and Rising Trader Boost apply, Effective Trading Volume will be calculated as follows:
Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier + min(Actual Trading Volume, Remaining Rising Trader Boost Cap) * Rising Trader Boost

The final ranking will be calculated based on users’ total Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period. A user’s total Effective Trading Volume is the sum of their daily Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period.
Example:

User A generates 10,000 USDT in actual trading volume on Day 1. The Day 1 Early Bird Boost Multiplier is 3.0x, and User A is also eligible for the 1.2x Rising Trader Boost. The Rising Trader Boost Cap is 5,000 USDT.
User A's Day 1 Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Early Bird Boost: 10,000 * 3.0 = 30,000 USDT

Rising Trader Boost: User A's actual trading volume (10,000 USDT) exceeds the Rising Trader Boost Cap (5,000 USDT), so only 5,000 USDT is eligible for the Rising Trader Boost = 5,000 * 1.2 = 6,000 USDT
Day 1 Effective Trading Volume = 30,000 + 6,000 = 36,000 USDT

After Day 1, User A's 5,000 USDT Rising Trader Boost Cap has been fully used. Therefore, User A will no longer receive the Rising Trader Boost for any subsequent trading volume during the Promotion Period.

Notes:

Daily reward = min(daily average Net USDC Holding, $1,000,000) × 2% ÷ 365
Net USDC Holding is measured via snapshots taken at random times between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 (UTC) each day

Rewards accrue daily and are settled weekly: Users who meet the weekly trading volume threshold will receive all rewards accrued during that weekly period. For these purposes, the daily average Net USDC Holding is the average of the Net USDC Holding recorded across that day’s snapshots.
